included: Assistant streaming reducer and activity presentation
Artifact Preview/Source/Log panes and toolbar polish
Targeted frontend and Python contract tests

wiring_manifest.renderability_contract: hasRenderableArtifact returns true only for text/html artifacts with same-origin /api/knowledge/v1/artifacts/ URLs; preview snapshots are accepted only from same-origin /api/knowledge/v1/artifact-snapshots/ while in preview/final state.

implemented: Assistant reducer accepts W2 event aliases, deduplicates events by id, merges action/tool start and output by call_id, sorts activities by timestamp, and preserves terminal status against late non-artifact events.

History restore replays completed invocation events before applying terminal state so refresh recovery shows existing assistant content, activities, summaries, and artifact state without duplicating events.

Immutable artifact.final has priority over late artifact.preview and artifact.created replay; late events may append logs or fill missing fields but cannot replace final artifact id, revision id, URI, sha256, source, or status.
Activity UI exposes stage, status, tool/action names, duration, plan completion, and collapsed input/output/error summaries so large JSON is not expanded by default.
Conversation UI keeps process visible, supports stop, reconnect, retry, refresh recovery, and does not force-scroll when the user manually scrolls away from latest.

BFF validates only real upstream artifact_preview/html_edit_complete HTML snapshots through html_artifact.py, saves short-lived tenant/workspace scoped snapshots, and emits blocked preview events when HTML is missing or unsafe.
BFF now preserves the provider-normalized event and appends a separate BFF-controlled artifact.preview event for valid or blocked snapshots.
Final HTML capture emits artifact.created and artifact.final after immutable artifact storage; frontend prefers final artifacts over preview snapshots in Preview and Source.
Artifact viewer provides Preview, Source, Log, version selection, local refresh, fullscreen, and download controls with controlled same-origin URL checks.
Toolbar groups lightweight icon controls and keeps Publish Skill as the only primary action; refresh is local and does not create a revision.
security_gates: No frontend mock/template HTML fallback is shipped.
Snapshot creation fails closed when upstream omits complete legal HTML or violates HTML artifact policy.
iframe sandbox remains provider/BFF controlled and does not add allow-same-origin.
Snapshot content route returns CSP, Cache-Control: no-store, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
Snapshot lookup is tenant and workspace scoped and expired snapshots return a closed failure.
Artifact object reads stay confined to immutable object storage.
Existing ZIP validation remains in force for traversal, duplicate paths, symlinks/special files, file counts, size limits, and compression ratio.
